generators.factoid: Pew's 2008 election survey found 32% of U.S. adults received at least one political chain email in the cycle. The average forwarder sent to 6.2 recipients. A typical 2006 'Who is Barack Obama?' email was forwarded an estimated 11 million times before fact-checkers caught up.

generators.factoid: The U.S. case for the 2003 Iraq invasion rested on three intelligence pillars that have all been retracted: the Niger uranium forgeries, the CURVEBALL informant (a single Iraqi defector held by German intelligence), and the aluminum-tube centrifuge misclassification. The CIA had warned the White House about Niger before the State of the Union; the claim ran anyway.

upgrades.name: Counter-Medal 'Doubt' Memo

generators.factoid: Swift Boat Veterans for Truth spent ~$22M attacking John Kerry's 1968-69 Navy service record in 2004. None of the veterans in the ads had served on Kerry's boats. The term 'swift-boating' entered the English language as a verb for attacking a documented credential by inventing a counter-narrative.

generators.factoid: Glenn Beck's nightly Fox News program (Jan 2009 – June 2011) reached ~3 million viewers at peak — the largest cable news audience in his timeslot. His chalkboard segments diagramming political conspiracies institutionalised a visual grammar later inherited by QAnon decoders and election-fraud advocates.

generators.factoid: Birther emails originated in 2008 Hillary Clinton primary-supporter circles before being adopted by far-right pundits. Trump's March 2011 endorsement on The View triggered a 6× increase in his Fox News appearances. He formally retracted in September 2016: 'President Barack Obama was born in the United States. Period.'

generators.factoid: By the mid-2000s, talking-point coordination was a daily institutional practice. The Republican National Committee, Democratic equivalents, and aligned think tanks emailed coordinated message documents to friendly cable bookers between 5-7 AM Eastern. Panel guests would often appear on three or four different shows in the same morning repeating identical phrasings.

prestige_bridge_copy: 2014 — the war goes on but the audience moves on. Birtherism does not die; it elects. The chain emails get a comment section, the comment section becomes a feed, the feed becomes a candidate. The escalator descends.
